answer_1.quote: document question answering is one of the most common applications of LLMs, where the model is presented with a document as context and asked to respond to related questions or summarize the text.

answer_2.quote: For QuALITY, we report the exact match (EM) score. For QMSum, we report the geometric mean of ROUGE scores. For the remaining datasets (Qasper, NarrativeQA, and HotpotQA), we report the F1 scores.
